brief:
A Jerusalem court's recommendations have revived questions about the future of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption trial, according to Al Jazeera. The proceedings, which faced uncertainty over recent months, now stand at a critical juncture as judicial authorities weigh next steps that could significantly affect both the trial's outcome and Netanyahu's political standing.

The timing of the court's recommendations has thrust Netanyahu's legal challenges back into the spotlight, intersecting with broader questions about his ability to remain in office while facing charges. The trial's trajectory remains subject to judicial decisions that could reshape the legal pressure on the Israeli leader and his efforts to navigate the prosecution.
dek: Court recommendations put the Israeli leader's trial, political future and efforts to evade prosecution back in focus.
title: Netanyahu's corruption trial returns to focus as court weighs recommendations
